lens: Geometry and proportion first, then materials and colour, then lighting on the seats, then artefacts. Fabrics were judged on photo-vs-render crops at matched physical scale (y_47306 resampled to the e4 studio scale of ~670 px/m for the middle seat and ~480 px/m for the mosaic seat; tiles resampled to 1 mm/px). Work files are in /tmp/claude-0/raterB12/ (fab_sheet.png, diamond_cmp.png, mos_photo480.png vs mos_e4.png, tick_cmp.png, q15s2.png vs p00s2.png, q15top.png vs p00top.png).

priorIssues.issue: w11a-1 / w11b-2 (medium): head-on, the headrest covers are brighter than the backs
priorIssues.evidence: q15 near-row cover/back L50 ratio is now 0.96 / 1.03 / 1.19 / 1.15 (r11: 1.12 / 1.34 / 1.45 / 1.39). y_47300 gives 0.72 / 0.87 / 0.54 / 0.71. The middle covers are still L 92-93 (#495176) against photo L 42-53 (#1e243c-#272d48). Row 2 covers read L 107-116 against photo 56-84. The covers are still the lightest element of the near row, where the photo shows them as the darkest.

priorIssues.issue: w11a-2 / w11b-1 (medium): the dash mosaic lacks its brick-laid block grid and reads as sparse cyan speckle
priorIssues.status: fixed for the grid, regressed in character
priorIssues.evidence: The block-level contrast now matches: an 8 mm blur gives p80/p20 1.27 (e4) against 1.26 (y_47306 right). At matched resolution (mos_photo480.png vs mos_e4.png), though, the photo is a continuous field of crisp horizontal dashes in rows 2.3-3.4 mm apart. Its blocks show only as tonal changes, and at 875 px/m it has no dark seams. The render shows solid pale tiles with dark mortar lines: dense blocks merge into a flat periwinkle fill and sparse blocks are near-empty navy. It reads as a brick wall or paving in q15 seat 2, e1, e4 and e4b. Native p90/p10 is 2.18 against 2.66 for the photo at the same resolution, so the dash texture is lost inside the blocks.

priorIssues.issue: w11a-3 (medium): the tick tile read as digital rain close up yet had weak columns at row distance
priorIssues.evidence: The chevron strokes are back. The dominant column period at matched scale is 8.1 px (render) against 9.9 px (photo), so the scale is right. Close up (tick_cmp.png), the dark channels between stroke columns are still deeper than in the photo, so the weave reads as chunky knit (e4, e7 pans). At q15 row distance, the near-row column CV is 0.091-0.102 against y_47300 tick backs 0.128-0.176. The columns are still too weak there.

priorIssues.issue: w11a-4 (medium): the fabric mix under-represented tick
priorIssues.evidence: econFab is a 6-cycle with tick in 3 of 6. The q15 near row is tick / mosaic / tick / fleck against y_47300's tick / fleck / tick / fleck. q16 now reads mostly tick and fleck, with diamond and mosaic as accents.

priorIssues.issue: w11a-5 (medium): the cover top roll was a fat tube and the flap hung too short
priorIssues.status: fixed for the roll; the drop is a conflicting target
priorIssues.evidence: The roll is now a thin sheet (e4z.png: no bead). In e4, the drop below the pad is 25 px for a 142 px pad (18 %) against 23-29 % in y_47306. In frontal q15, however, the cover runs 28 % of the pad height below the pad (seat 2: pad 115-295, cover to 345 in the 2x zoom q15s2.png). In the frontal official photo y_47300, the cover ends about 5 % ABOVE the pad bottom (p00s2.png). Do not lengthen the flap further; see questionsForUser.

priorIssues.issue: w11b-3 (medium): the diamond figures were scanline-hatched, too dark, low in contrast and ~25 % too small
priorIssues.status: fixed for the hatching and size, overshot in contrast
priorIssues.evidence: The scanlines are gone and the figures are now ~0.065-0.075 m (diamond_cmp.png). Contrast is now too high and the ground too dark. A 3 px blur gives p80/p20 1.66 (e1) and 2.17 (e3) against 1.38 (y_47302 middle) and 1.42 (y_47306 left). Quartile colours: ground #1b2142 against photo #2d4180, light/dark 3.20 against 2.15, mean saturation 0.43 against 0.51. The figures sit as isolated polka-diamonds on a regular grid, while the photo shows a chained diagonal lattice on a bright royal ground.

issues.title: Dash mosaic reads as a brick wall: solid pale tiles outlined by dark mortar instead of a dash field with tonal blocks
issues.evidence: mos_photo480.png (y_47306 right resampled to the render scale) vs mos_e4.png: the photo is crisp horizontal dashes everywhere, rows 2.3-3.4 mm apart, dashes 3.5-14 mm long, and no seams visible even at 875 px/m (mos_native6x.png). The render's dense blocks are flat periwinkle fills and its sparse blocks near-empty, with a continuous dark seam grid. The block-level contrast is right (1.27 vs 1.26); the fine texture is too weak (p90/p10 2.18 vs 2.66). Visible in q15 seat 2, e1, e4b and q16 rows.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py y_mosaic(): (a) seam factor 0.35 -> 0.08, applied on only ~50 % of the block edges (rng), so blocks show by tone, not outline. (b) Dash rows every 3 px (2.3 mm at 0.78 mm/px), not 2 px, so even dense blocks keep visible navy between rows (a 2 px row pitch with 1 px dashes minifies to a solid fill). (c) Densities {0.30, 0.45, 0.62} instead of {0.12, 0.30, 0.55}, so no block goes empty. (d) Lift (5.2, 5.4, 5.6) -> (4.4, 4.6, 5.0) with the ground at 0.88 instead of 0.94, keeping the mean while raising per-dash contrast. Then check that a matched-scale crop has p90/p10 >= 2.5 and 8 mm blur p80/p20 ~1.25.

issues.title: Diamond fabric too contrasty, on a ground too dark and grey; figures isolated on a regular grid
issues.evidence: 3 px blur p80/p20 1.66 (e1) / 2.17 (e3) against 1.38 (y_47302 middle) / 1.42 (y_47306 left). Quartile colours: ground #1b2142 vs #2d4180, figures #737ea7 vs #879fda, light/dark 3.20 vs 2.15, saturation 0.43 vs 0.51. In diamond_cmp.png the photo figures chain along the diagonals on a bright royal-blue ground; the render shows separate pale lozenges on navy that read as argyle or ikat polka. Too legible in q15 far rows.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_diamond(): ground = 1.15 * (tm + 0.4 * (t - tm)) (was 0.85 *), lift [4.0, 3.8, 3.1] -> [2.7, 2.6, 2.2], and hd range 0.034-0.039 -> 0.040-0.044 so neighbouring figures touch along the diagonals (a chained lattice). Drop the 10 % bright specks to 4 %. Shared-file line in 09_seats.js: yFabricB c photoBase('#565e82') -> photoBase('#4f5f9c', 'y_diamond') for saturation ~0.5. Target p80/p20 ~1.4 at a 3 mm blur.

issues.title: Headrest covers still brighter than the fabric head-on
issues.evidence: q15 cover/back ratio 0.96 / 1.03 / 1.19 / 1.15 against y_47300 0.72 / 0.87 / 0.54 / 0.71. Middle covers #495176 (L 92-93) against #1e243c-#272d48 (L 42-53). Row 2 covers L 107-116 against 56-84. In y_47300 the dark cover rectangles are the strongest cue down the cabin; in the render they read as mid-slate patches.
issues.fix: 09_seats.js yCover (shared, one line): c '#434a68' -> '#363c58' and r 0.50 -> 0.68, keeping LAYER.leather. In 09a_econ.js, tip the plate a further ~4 deg: change the 0.55 / 0.585 SEC z-offsets from -0.112 / -0.106 to -0.118 / -0.110, so the face normal turns down, away from the ceiling-light reflection. Target a q15 cover/back ratio of ~0.75.

issues.title: Front view shows a white shell rim and grey knobs along every back top; the photo shows a fabric-wrapped top
issues.evidence: q15top.png vs p00top.png. In every near-row back, q15 shows a ~8 px (about 1.7 cm) white hood rim across the top and grey round side knobs at the top corners. In y_47300 the back tops are rounded fabric with a dark navy edge, no white visible from the front, and no knobs. The back also rises ~9.6 cm above the pad in q15 (46 px of 210 px back width), against ~3 cm in y_47300 (8 / 117 px) and 7-8 cm in y_47306.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js back loft: extend the top fabric sections ~1.5 cm higher and ~1 cm aft so the fabric wraps over the hood lip, or pull the RS shell-hood front lip ~1 cm aft and 1 cm down so it hides behind the fabric crown when seen head-on. Move the hood side knobs (if they are the hood pivots) 2 cm aft so they are hidden from the front. Keep the back height until the headrest position is confirmed (questionsForUser).

issues.title: Contact-darkening strips read as hard black outlines down the back edges
issues.evidence: In e4z.png, e1 and e4b, a crisp 2-3 px near-black line (#1d2238 strips 6 mm wide) runs the full height of both back edges. In y_47306 the crease is a soft gradient of shade 1-2 cm wide.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js contact strips: width 0.006 -> 0.014, colour '#1d2238' -> '#283052', and push the strip 2 mm deeper (z -0.05 -> -0.052), so it is partly occluded by the fabric edge and reads as a soft crease shadow.

issues.title: Tick columns too weak at row distance; channels too deep close up (knit look)
issues.evidence: q15 near-row column CV 0.091-0.102 vs y_47300 0.128-0.176. tick_cmp.png: the render's dark channels between stroke columns are deeper and wider than in the photo, so it reads as chunky knit (e7 pans).
issues.fix: make_swatches.py synth_y_tick(): column envelope 0.22 -> 0.32, and lift the darkest values of the crop with ratio = max(ratio, 0.45 * mean) before the envelope, so the columns gain low-frequency weight while the inter-column channels get shallower.

issues.title: Petal flecks slightly too strong (snow at aisle distance)
issues.evidence: q15 seat 4 fleck back: sd after a 1 px blur is 0.187 against y_47300 fleck backs 0.142-0.144. At matched scale the flecks are whiter (tile light #a9c8ff-ish vs photo #8aa0d0).

issues.title: Handset too thin and too close under the screen
issues.evidence: y_47305: dock width/height <= 3.3 (the bottom is cropped at >= 87 px), and the screen-to-dock gap is 38 px = 6.3 % of the screen width. q18: 204 x 46 px (4.4) and a 16 px gap (3.8 %).
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js handset / dock: height +30 %, and move it ~1 cm down (gap ~0.017 m for a ~0.28 m screen).

issues.title: Pillow slightly too tall for its width
issues.evidence: y_47300 pillows h/w 0.66 (seat 2: 91 x 60 px, near eye level); model 0.29 / 0.39 = 0.74.

issues.title: (Lighting area) q16 fabrics greyer and more lavender than y_47301
issues.evidence: q16 backs: saturation 0.41, B/G 1.47, R/G 0.87. y_47301: 0.48-0.55, 1.60-1.74, 0.73-0.89. q15 matches y_47300 (0.48 vs 0.44), so this is light colour or exposure in the q16 view, not the material.
issues.fix: For lighting/integration: check the cabin light white balance on the q16 view. No econ change.

questionsForUser: In the frontal official photo y_47300, the headrest pads sit almost at the top of the backs (the back rises ~3 cm above the pad) and the leather cover ends at the pad's lower edge. In y_47306 the back rises 7-8 cm and the cover hangs ~25 % below the pad. Is the y_47300 headrest raised (6-way headrest), so the model should keep the lowered y_47306 position? Do you have a photo with the headrest fully down taken head-on?
Footrest form: y_47303 seems to show a light-grey U-shaped wire loop under each seat, while the model has two ribbed paddles per seat. Is there an in-service close-up of the row 31+ footrest?
The grey round knobs at the top corners of each back (e9, q15) — are they real hood pivots? No ANA photo shows them from the front.
